第482章 你是懂爱的人（第1页）
未婚的男女在一起，在那个时代是不允许的。
可是沈沛珊并不是一个被礼教所束缚的人。
而蓝烨磊是个不拘一格的将军，更是不在乎这些说法。
最主要的是，他们相信皇甫皓轩与蓝若晴虽然彼此相爱，但是一定会拿捏好尺度。
更何况，二人已经是皇上亲自赐婚的未婚夫妻。
就算是两人真的发生了些什么，恐怕也没人敢说些什么。
皇甫皓轩看到蓝若晴点头，承认了她要与他浪迹天涯的事不假，高兴的抱起蓝若晴，在地上转着圈。
满树的杏花娇艳欲滴，青青的草地春意萌发。
一对白衣仙子飘荡在其间，让整个画面如诗如画，如梦如真。
皇甫皓轩终于停了下来，兴奋的问着蓝若晴：“你最想去的地方是哪，我好去安排。”
蓝若晴被皇甫皓轩转的有些晕，扶着他的手臂说：“我还没想好，而且我从来没有去过外面。如果要去，我想先帮辰师伯和花月娘找他们的族人。一来可以游历山水，二来可以帮他们一些忙。最主要的是，虽然才与花月娘分开没多久，可是我已经有些想她了。”
“好！那我们就先去找师傅和花月娘。只是若晴，我们什么时候出发？”
“我知道，你有太多的牵挂和担心。你惦记着每一个人，心中总是为他们设想。若晴，就是这一点才吸引我！你这颗懂得爱别人的心，才是我最爱的。所以当初你的脸上还有疤痕的时候，我仍然是那样的爱你！因为我爱的是你的心！只是今后，你也要收收你的心了。”皇甫皓轩突然一脸严肃的，看着皇甫皓轩。
“因为你的心里，还要装下一个我！以后还有很多个人！”
“我的心里早就装着你了，可是还有很多个人，是谁呢？表哥？小溪？映雪么？还是谁？”蓝若晴一头的雾水，她不知道皇甫皓轩说的话是什么意思。
“你的心里有了我以后，当然还会有很多个小的你，和小的我……”皇甫皓轩在蓝若晴的耳边小声的说着：“他们是我们生命的延续，是我们爱的象征……”
“你讨厌！”蓝若晴终于听明白了皇甫皓轩话里的意思。

原来，他已经想到了将来要生宝宝的事情。
经历过重生的她，怎么会不懂得皇甫皓轩话里的意思？
“我不理你了！”蓝若晴跺着脚，害羞的跑开了。
“你怎么可以不理我？”皇甫皓轩赖皮的在后面追着蓝若晴，可是无论他怎样努力，都追不上她。
此时的蓝若晴功力已经今非昔比，皇甫皓轩即使再练上个三五年，恐怕也追不上他。
终于，皇甫皓轩停下脚步，努力的调整着呼吸。
远方传来了马蹄声，不知是谁这么着急的赶过来。
蓝若晴也停下了脚步，与皇甫皓轩站在一起，看着远方。
如果不是有极为重要的事情，是不会有人来打扰他们的。

Chapter 482 You are the one who understands love (Page 1)
Unmarried men and women were not allowed to be together in that era.
But Shen Peishan is not a person bound by ethics.
And Lan Yelei is an eclectic general, and he doesn't care about these claims.
The most important thing is that they believe that although Huangfu Haoxuan and Lan Ruoqing love each other, they will definitely know how to handle it.
What's more, the two of them are already an unmarried couple personally granted marriage by the emperor.
Even if something really happened between the two of them, no one would dare to say anything.
When Huangfu Haoxuan saw Lan Ruoqing nodding and admitted that she wanted to wander the world with him, he happily picked up Lan Ruoqing and spun around on the ground.
The trees are full of apricot blossoms, and the green grass is sprouting with spring.
A pair of fairies in white clothes float in the middle, making the whole scene as poetic and picturesque as a dream.
Huangfu Haoxuan finally stopped and asked Lan Ruoqing excitedly: "Where do you want to go most? I can arrange it."
Lan Ruoqing was a little dazed by Huangfu Haoxuan. She held his arm and said, "I haven't thought about it yet, and I have never been outside. If I want to go, I want to help Uncle Chen and Hua Yueniang find their clansmen first. First, I can travel around the mountains and rivers, and second, I can help them. The most important thing is, although I have only been separated from Hua Yueniang for a short time, I already miss her a little."
"Okay! Then let's go find the master and Hua Yueniang first. But Ruoqing, when will we set off?"
"I know that you have too many cares and worries. You miss everyone and always think about them in your heart. Ruoqing, this is what attracts me! Your heart that knows how to love others is what I love most. So when you still had scars on your face, I still loved you so much! Because it is your heart that I love! But from now on, you will also have to accept your heart." Huangfu Haoxuan suddenly looked at Huangfu Haoxuan with a serious face.
"Because you still have to pretend to be me in your heart! There will be many others in the future!"
"I have had you in my heart for a long time, but there are many other people. Who are they? Cousin? Xiaoxi? Yingxue? Or who?" Lan Ruoqing was confused. She didn't know what Huangfu Haoxuan meant.
"After you have me in your heart, of course there will be many little yous and little mes..." Huangfu Haoxuan whispered in Lan Ruoqing's ear: "They are the continuation of our lives and the symbol of our love..."
"You hate it!" Lan Ruoqing finally understood the meaning of Huangfu Haoxuan's words.
It turned out that he had already thought about having a baby in the future.
How could she, who had experienced rebirth, not understand the meaning of Huangfu Haoxuan's words?
"I'm ignoring you!" Lan Ruoqing stamped her feet and ran away shyly.
"How can you ignore me?" Huangfu Haoxuan shamelessly chased Lan Ruoqing, but no matter how hard he tried, he couldn't catch up with her.
At this time, Lan Ruoqing's skills are no longer what they used to be. Even if Huangfu Haoxuan practices for another three to five years, he probably won't be able to catch up with him.
Finally, Huangfu Haoxuan stopped and tried hard to adjust his breathing.
The sound of horse hooves came from the distance, and I didn't know who was rushing over in such a hurry.
Lan Ruoqing also stopped and stood with Huangfu Haoxuan, looking into the distance.
If there wasn't something extremely important, no one would bother them.
